title: The SpaceX pad that handled flight 1 in 2010 just handled flight 700
title_candidates: SpaceX's first rocket launch vs. their 700th, from the exact same pad
16 years of SpaceX in one video, and the first launch hurts to watch
The SpaceX pad that handled flight 1 in 2010 just handled flight 700
How SpaceX went from barely reaching orbit to 700 rocket launches
SpaceX filmed their 700th launch next to footage of their very first one
caption:
SpaceX just hit 700 Falcon 9 launches, and flights 1 and 700 both left from the exact same pad.

In 2010 the whole goal was just to reach orbit and prove the rocket worked. Now a booster lands itself, gets refueled, and does it again. 700 times in 16 years, from the same strip of concrete in Florida.

The gap between those two clips is the whole story of modern spaceflight.
